title: Strictification of a circuit family
statement: Let $C$ be a family assigning a circuit with $n$ input vertices to each natural number $n$. Define a new family that uses $C$'s circuit unchanged at $n=0$ and uses the strictification of $C$'s circuit at every positive $n$.
